parts.gloss: those who do not bestow love

words.gloss: those who do not bestow love

literal: In the waking state, those who do not bestow love, they will blame; in dream, their lover, those who do not see.
translation: Only those who do not see their lover in their dreams will blame him for not showing love in the waking state.
modern: கனவில் தன் காதலரைக் காணப் பெறாதவர்களே, நனவில் தமக்கு அன்பு செய்யாத காதலரை நொந்து கொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: The heroine explains that she has no reason to complain about her lover's absence or lack of affection during the day. She asserts that only women who are unable to meet their lovers in their dreams (கனவினால் காதலர்க் காணாதவர்) will feel pained and blame them (நோவர்) for not showing love in the waking state (நனவினால் நல்காரை). Since her lover constantly visits and unites with her in her dreams, she remains content and free from resentment.
